name: Agent Keeper
summary: Turns a machine that only has an Automaton Runner into a GitHub Actions agent machine, with no SSH.
description: Agent Keeper starts the next agent issue from the board every 10 minutes (the Pick up Action), shows the queue, the machine and its disks, and installs Claude Code, gh, git, Docker and the build tools on a machine, registers it as a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner with the agent label and runs it as a service. Set up can be run again safely and changes nothing that is already done; Remove unregisters the runner and removes the service; Update tools upgrades the tools. The page shows the runner's state, the tool versions, the disk and the last log of each run. It runs its scripts as root on the machine through runner:host-exec, so it works only when a system administrator has turned on host access for the server, owns the app and has approved it for that machine. A runner registration or removal token is typed on the page for each run, goes to the script once and is never saved or logged; the app stores no token. The Pick up Action and the queue read the board with the secret AGENT_GH_TOKEN.

application.description: Starts the next agent issue every 10 minutes, shows the queue and turns a Runner machine into a GitHub Actions agent machine from one page.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py keeper.py actions/pick/board.py actions/pick/main.py actions/verify/main.py && mkdir -p dist/ui dist/scripts && cp main.py keeper.py actions/pick/board.py index.html keeper.js keeper.css dist/ && cp scripts/*.sh dist/scripts/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: API_BASE_URL
settings.description: Optional. Base URL of this Automaton server's API; normally the server provides it, so leave empty

settings.name: AGENT_MACHINE_ID
settings.description: The machine to set up: its id (a GUID) from Studio, Runners. It must be a Machine Management Runner an administrator approved this app for

settings.name: AGENT_REPO
settings.description: Where the runner is registered: owner/repo, or an organisation name

settings.name: AGENT_RUNNER_LABELS
settings.description: Labels for the runner, separated by commas

settings.name: AGENT_RUNNER_USER
settings.description: The unprivileged user on the machine that runs the runner service (created if missing)

settings.name: AGENT_DOCKER_ACCESS
settings.description: Default off. Set to true to add the runner user to the docker group. That is root on the machine for every job the runner runs

settings.name: AGENT_BOARD
settings.description: The GitHub project board the Pick up Action reads, as owner/number

settings.name: AGENT_REPOS
settings.description: Repositories whose Ready cards are picked, separated by spaces

settings.name: AGENT_CLI
settings.description: Agent tool for implementation runs: claude or agy. Empty keeps the repository variable AGENT_CLI

settings.name: AGENT_MODEL
settings.description: Model for implementation runs. Empty keeps the repository variable AGENT_MODEL

settings.name: AGENT_REVIEW_CLI
settings.description: Agent tool for the main review: claude or agy (the security pass stays on Claude). Empty keeps the repository variable

settings.name: AGENT_REVIEW_MODEL
settings.description: Model for the main review. Empty keeps the repository variable

settings.name: AGENT_PARALLEL
settings.description: Runs at once: 1 or 2. With 2, Set up registers a second runner service and Pick up starts a second card only in another area

settings.name: VERIFY_ENABLED
settings.description: Default on (true). Set to false to stop scheduled release verification and show Verification off in the Queue

secrets.name: AGENT_GH_TOKEN
secrets.description: GitHub token that reads and moves cards on the board, labels issues and starts agent-issue.yml. Needs the project, repo and workflow scopes

schedules.name: Pick up
schedules.description: Start the next agent issue and move cards whose run opened a pull request to Verify

schedules.name: Verify
schedules.description: Start release verification on the test server when a new version is installed and cards wait in Verify
